critique: The sphere itself is excellent: three concentric particle shells (Sphere-Layered confirmed), fine grid texture, strong volume read from nested shells and limb density, centered on clean black. But rotation is unverifiable between t1 and t4 — a near-perfectly symmetric sphere is rotation-invariant in stills; the FAffectPosX 15 surface features are too subtle to track. The criterion needs visible asymmetric features that travel.

suggestions.why: stronger field displacement = visible lumps/streams on the shells that the Y-rotation carries around
larger field scale = coherent continent-sized features instead of uniform ripple
